title: Ceremonial Beast
move_pattern: Starts with Stamp (applies 160 Plow), then repeats Plow. When stunned via Plow removal, transitions to Stun move, then cycles: Beast Cry → Stomp → Crush → Beast Cry.
notes: This monster has two distinct phases. In the first phase, it uses Stamp followed by repeated Plow attacks. When the player removes the Plow power (likely through a specific card interaction), the monster is stunned and enters a second phase with different move patterns. The Stun move must be performed once before transitioning. After unstunning, the monster cycles through Beast Cry, Stomp, and Crush, with Beast Cry applying Ringing debuff to the player.
